svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Containers and Docker, slide 7. One kernel, many containers
svg.desc: Proof captured on the course VM: uname -a on the VM (hostname devops, Debian 13), in a Debian container (hostname 50a2473665c5) and in an Alpine container (hostname 47dc50dac49b) all report the same kernel, 6.12.111+deb13-cloud-amd64: three systems, one shared kernel.
svg.text: Captured on our course VM: three different systems answer with the very same kernel.
